''See also: [[Pilgrim Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Pilgrims]] are members of the [[Luminian Order]], an organized and disciplined group characterized by their all-white clothing and silver sun medallions. They serve as symbols of healing and protection, often acting as religious figures or companions to imperial officials. While many [[Pilgrims]] focus on medical skills and alchemy, the [[Order]] maintains strict requirements for those seeking to wield more significant power. To become a [[Soulbound]], an individual must serve the [[Guild]] for many years, combat various [[Elders]], and demonstrate proficiency in traditional healing. Through a process known as [[Awakening]], some [[Pilgrims]] gain the ability to manifest light barriers or other abilities, though this process can sometimes result in mental instability or a fanatical obsession with destroying [[Elderspawn]]. The most powerful among them possess medallions that function as Beacons, capable of providing profound restoration and light. The [[Order]] is led by a [[Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head]], and its history is rooted in the legacy of [[Loreli]], Daughter of the Emperor, who was considered the first Pilgrim. While they are generally viewed as righteous protectors, their role can range from performing incantations to drive away shadows to serving in high-ranking capacities within [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Pilgrim is a man dressed in white robes. He carries a copy of [[Meditations on the Unknown God]] and wears a medallion featuring a [[White Sun]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Pilgrim addresses [[Darius Allbright{{!}}Darius]] as [[Knight-Adjunct]]. [[Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster]] has expressed a desire for a Pilgrim he can trust, and [[Shera]] has issued orders for [[the Reader]] to be brought before a Pilgrim.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Pilgrims]] of the [[Luminian Order]] utilize alchemy and medical skill to heal others. They also possess [[Soulbound]] power and recite an incantation when they suspect a spawn of the [[Creeping Shadow]].}}
